title: Innokin Kwik 35K Kiwi Passionfruit Guava Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Kiwi Passionfruit Guava blends tangy Kiwi with lush Passionfruit and smooth Guava for a vibrant tropical profile that remains fresh throughout use. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and 10ml refill container for the Innokin Kwik 35K device. The mesh-coil design and auto-feed system keep the coil saturated, ensuring consistent flavour and vapour. How to Set Up Innokin Kwik 35K Prefilled Pod Step 1 Insert the prefilled pod into the Kwik 35K device until it clicks. Step 2 Fit the 10ml refill container securely into the base compartment. Step 3 Inhale on the mouthpiece to vape. Replace the pod pack once both chambers are empty. ✅ You're all set!
